title: Phishing Email with Spoofed DocuSign Domain
id: 5a7d2c1e-3b4f-4a01-9f2a-4c8d9e1f2b3a
description: Detects outbound emails with subject lines mimicking DocuSign notifications and containing suspicious domains.
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
references:
    - https://example.com/phishing-campaign-docusign-2026
logsource:
    category: email
    product: microsoft_exchange
detection:
    docusign_subject:
        subject|contains: 'Action Required: Review and Sign'
        subject|contains: 'Financial'
        subject|contains: 'Q1'
    suspicious_domain:
        body|re: 'https?://[^/]*docusign[^.]*[.]xyz|https?://[^/]*docusign[^.]*[.]top'
    condition: docusign_subject and suspicious_domain
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate use of non-standard domains (rare)
level: medium
